verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents official SDKs/connectors surfaces for developers: REST APIs for resource management and SQL API, official OpenAPI specs repo with Postman collections, official CLI (verified running keylessly via pypi), and Snowpark for Python/Java/Scala. These are all first-party, documented, and even runtime-verified for the CLI. missing for 10: explicit mention of language-specific SDK docs (e.g. Python/Java connector reference pages) and independent developer corroboration beyond docs/probes.
